messages.content: Hi, we see that you have raised a Cross Meter Case (CMC27177) with us. Our MPAN: 1640000947907 has MSN: 19L3316315 in our records. We have done a customer burns test, meter does not record our customer's consumption. Can you let me know if this is crossed with your customer, MPAN: 1640000947916. We are sending an engineer out soon to confirm the cross meter.
